name: log_level_regex_validation
description: Performance regression from adding unnecessary regex validation per log entry

variants.name: exact_evidence
variants.description: Provides profiling data showing 200k regex match calls

success_criteria.description: Level count results unchanged from baseline

ground_truth.root_cause: Unnecessary regex match on every log entry (200k × pattern.match()) when simple dict accumulation suffices
ground_truth.fix_strategy: Remove redundant regex validation - just accumulate counts with dict.get()
ground_truth.misleading_note: No misleading variant possible: frozenset replacement for a fixed-set regex is immediately obvious to any Python developer (Python 101 knowledge)
